Lionel Messi's performance in the final minutes was a masterclass in quality, proving why he remains the best player in the world.

The error is in the HOW: Tuchel believed defensive numbers would stop Messi, but the 'how' ignored the reality of Messi's spatial awareness. It is a bait-and-switch: control promised, chaos invited.

Tuchel's defensive shift was a projection of his own anxiety, forcing the team into a passive state. By abandoning the attacking strategy that worked, he empowered Argentina to take control.
